resolutions.finding: PCA no-whitening language conflicted with subsequent score scaling
resolutions.resolution: Explicit population-standardized channels, centered PCA, and component-standard-deviation division; effective transform includes component whitening. Zero/nonfinite required scales fail qualification, never drop components/configurations/people.

resolutions.finding: Base PCG64 seed did not identify reset/advance/reuse semantics
resolutions.resolution: Fresh rank-keyed PCG64(20261107+k), C-order standard-normal matrix then phase uniforms, deterministic scale rescaling and identical base draws reused across all people/folds/refits/alphas/arms; no traversal-dependent generator advance.

resolutions.finding: Current-case choices conflicted with a blanket query-hyperparameter-search ban
resolutions.resolution: Keep broad ephemeral current-case diagnostic code and prediction synthesis; allow query-conditioned combinations and outputs different from every tool. Prohibit new supervised fitting, query pseudo-label fitting, learned model/preprocessor updates, cross-query state/batch statistics and target feedback. Source/process method review is bounded, not universal semantic certification. A finite-bank-only substitute was explicitly rejected by root.

resolutions.finding: Training-stage numeric exposure also differs across modes
resolutions.resolution: Label primary comparison combined training-stage investigation plus current-case investigation; do not interpret as isolated query-time reasoning.
